scope: R7 evaluator invariance under an explicit closed whitelist of coupon-decorated framed-link diagram moves, plus a conditional presentation-independence theorem.

primary_sources.locator: Theorem 6.1, only in the simple-signature scope recorded by Selinger Caveat 4.31

obligations.implementation: mandatory source_ref, source_locator, and source_scope_caveat fields

trusted_inputs.exact_content: The explicit cup-crossing-cap positive and negative kinks evaluate to the chosen twist and inverse twist.
trusted_inputs.not_assumed: No arbitrary framed-link evaluator equality is included.

trusted_inputs.exact_content: close_X(f then g) equals close_Y(g then f).
trusted_inputs.not_assumed: No Reidemeister, Kirby, or presentation equality is included.

trusted_inputs.exact_content: Two admitted closed diagrams representing one framed link are connected by GeneratedIsotopy over the exact whitelist.
trusted_inputs.not_assumed: Evaluator equality is not a field and arbitrary CertifiedMove injection is impossible.
trusted_inputs.caveat: Selinger Theorem 4.30 carries Caveat 4.31; this input is therefore visible and conditional rather than claimed as fully formalized topology.

silent_failure_guards: Tensor parenthesization is retained and every associator/unitor in Reidemeister III and snake expansions is visible.
Positive and negative Reidemeister II are separate declarations.
All four left/right primal/dual snake orientations are separate declarations.
Framed Reidemeister I cannot be used without both positive and negative kink equations.
Closure cut motion cannot be used without trace cyclicity.
TaggedMove is a closed inductive whitelist and has no arbitrary CertifiedMove constructor.
GeneratedIsotopy context closure uses the previously proved typed one-hole context congruence theorem.
The source coherence caveat is a mandatory field and is repeated in the reference ledger and terminal artifact.
Axiom audit rejects sorryAx and native_decide proof oracles.
All five omission/injection mutations fail for their expected Lean diagnostics.
explicit_non_claims: This does not formalize the full topological proof of framed-link regular-diagram completeness.
This does not remove Selinger Caveat 4.31 or prove that Shum Theorem 6.1 covers arbitrary repository coupon signatures.
This does not yet interpret every R6 serialized presentation as a categorical Diagram.
This does not prove any Kirby handle slide or handle cancellation.
This does not prove four-manifold presentation independence.
This does not define the homologically twisted Crane-Yetter invariant.
